Kit summary

Tide Big HitBasic
Deals 22% DMG of Seth's Max HP to a single enemy, with a 20% chance to inflict [Suffocated] for 1 turn. The chance is increased by 15% if the target is under [Wet] or [Cold] status.
Deep Sea PowerActiveExclusive Lv.3
Grants all allies a [Shield] by 25% of Seth's Max HP for 2 turns and increases all allies' Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns.
Deep Sea Shield Lv.3Seth additionally casts Deep Sea Power 1 time at the beginning of each wave. Increases the Shield value of Deep Sea Power to 45% of Seth's Max HP until the wave transition.
Deep Sea BloodlinePassiveExclusive Lv.2
There is 90% chance to inflict [Wet II] on the attacker for 2 turns when under basic attack, and 90% chance to inflict [Cold II] on the attacker for 2 turns when under skill attack. Seth and Sewell will activate [Brother Togetherness] when both of them are deployed. [Brother Togetherness]: Increases Sewell's DEF by 25% and Seth's Max HP Cap by 15%. Besides, when either Seth or Sewell dies, the survivor will revive the dead with 35% of the survivor's Max HP by deducting 15% of his current HP. [Brother Togetherness] only takes effect once each wave.
Deep Sea Shield Lv.2Seth gains an additional 12% Max HP Cap. Restores self 8% Max HP when taking Basic Attack DMG or Skill DMG dealt by enemies with [Wet] or [Cold] and reduces 1 self skill CD randomly by 1 turn when Seth restores HP by this effect each time.
Crystal of LifeActiveExclusive Lv.1
Restores all allies' HP by 22% of Seth's Max HP and grants [Ripple II] to all allies for 2 turns.
Deep Sea Shield Lv.1Crystal of Life additionally increases all allies' ATK by 40% for 2 turns.
